mentions.name: New Smalltalk VM
mentions.description: This project is a Smalltalk virtual machine built from scratch that takes advantage of modern hardware with full multicore support, paired with a web-based system browser so development can be done remotely.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a new Smalltalk VM from scratch that better utilizes modern hardware (full multicore support) and a web-based system browser so I can develop with it remotely.
mentions.author: wild_egg
